outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a representative time-lapse of mock-treated and saccharin-treated E. coli cells, implying the experiment was performed on multiple cells/replicates, but the caption gives no indication of how many times the experiment was repeated or what kind of replicate (biological/technical, number of cells or independent experiments) the images represent.

Panel B presents representative phase-contrast/fluorescence images at several time points for a single strain (JD1709) treated with saccharin, but no statement gives the number or type of replicates underlying these representative images.

replicate_statements: The images shown are representative examples from a minimum of three biological replicates.
